thread:
zane: Heads up — onboarding CI started failing after I upgraded @redwood/sdk to 0.8.0. The new package.json exports removed the legacy CJS surface and our Jest setup (Node 14) now crashes.

priya: Can you paste the CI failure?

zane: Sure: ```TypeError: require('@redwood/sdk').default is undefined at examples/onboarding/test/setup.js:5:18```

hao: We're also seeing Cloudflare Worker emulation error when the sample imports the SDK as a default: ```Error: The requested module '@redwood/sdk' does not provide an export named 'default'``` — edge runtimes prefer conditional exports and are sensitive to how `exports` is laid out.

priya: Summary: two UX issues — runtime break (edge + CJS) and mismatch between runtime exports and published TypeScript defs (index.d.ts still has `export default`). That confuses TS consumers who `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'`.

zane: Quick user-facing workaround I added to the sample README: use named imports or the `require` fallback: ```// ESM named
import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk'
// CJS safe
const sdk = require('@redwood/sdk').default || require('@redwood/sdk')```

hao: I'll open a small patch to restore a CJS fallback entry in package.json ("exports": { ".": { "require": "./cjs/index.js", "import": "./dist/esm/index.js" } }) and add a cjs/index.js shim that sets `module.exports = require('../dist/esm').default || require('../dist/esm')`.

priya: Also update index.d.ts to provide a default export type that delegates to the named types so TS doesn't break on `import Redwood from ...`. Add a changelog note about moving to ESM-first while keeping a compat layer.

qa-bot: ci: published canary @redwood/sdk@0.8.1-canary.3 — running samples matrix (node12/14/16 + worker emulation).

zane: After my local smoke the canary fixes the worker import failure. I still want a CI gate that runs the onboarding sample under a worker emulator before we cut releases. Filed ISSUE-1333.

hao: Agreed. Also adding a release checklist step to run a small Node CJS require smoke test: `node -e "console.log(require('@redwood/sdk'))"` after packaging.

priya: Thanks — once tests pass we'll merge the compat patch and backport the README change to Dedicated docs. I'll also update the SDK README to show both `import * as` and `import {}` patterns and a note for Node <12 users. :+1:
